title: 授業料給付の算定式

blocks.text: SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE. This Act may be cited as the ``Veterans Education Equity Act of 2011''. SEC. 2. PROTECTING EQUITY FOR TUITION AND FEES FOR INDIVIDUALS ENTITLED TO ASSISTANCE UNDER THE POST-9/11 EDUCATIONAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM WHO ARE PURSUING PROGRAMS OF EDUCATION AT INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER LEARNING. (a) In General.--Clause (i) of subparagraph (A) of paragraph (1) of subsection (c) of section 3313 of title 38, United States Code, is amended to read as follows: ``(i) In the case of a program of education pursued at a public institution of higher learning, the lesser of-- ``(I) the actual net cost for tuition and fees assessed by the institution for the program of education after the application of-- ``(aa) any waiver of, or reduction in, tuition and fees; and ``(bb) any scholarship, or other Federal, State, institutional, or employer- based aid or assistance (other than loans and any funds provided under section 401(b) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1070a)) that is provided directly to the institution and specifically designated for the sole purpose of defraying tuition and fees; or
blocks.translation: 第1条　略称。この法律は「2011年退役軍人教育公平法」と称することができる。第2条　2001年9月11日以降の教育支援制度の対象で、高等教育機関に通う人の授業料・手数料の公平性を確保する。（a）合衆国法典第38編第3313条（c）（1）（A）（i）を次のように改める。（i）公立の高等教育機関の教育課程について、次のうち低い額とする。（I）その課程の授業料・手数料の実質負担額。免除・減額と、授業料・手数料の支払いだけを目的に教育機関へ直接支給される奨学金その他の連邦・州・教育機関・雇用主による援助を充当した後の額とする。ただし、ローンと1965年高等教育法第401条（b）の資金を除く。または、

blocks.text: ``(II) the greater of-- ``(aa) the actual net cost for in-State tuition and fees assessed by the institution for the program of education after the application of-- ``(AA) any waiver of, or reduction in, tuition and fees; and ``(BB) any scholarship, or other Federal, State, institutional, or employer-based aid or assistance (other than loans and any funds provided under section 401(b) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1070a)) that is provided directly to the institution and specifically designated for the sole purpose of defraying tuition and fees; or ``(bb) the amount equal to-- ``(AA) for the academic year beginning on August 1, 2011, $17,500; or ``(BB) for any subsequent academic year, the amount in effect for the previous academic year under this subclause, as increased by the percentage increase equal to the most recent percentage increase determined under section 3015(h) of this title.''. (b) Effective Date.--The amendment made by subsection (a) shall apply with respect to the payment of educational assistance for an academic year beginning on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.
blocks.translation: （II）次のうち高い額。（aa）州内居住者向け授業料・手数料の実質負担額。免除・減額と、授業料・手数料の支払いだけを目的に教育機関へ直接支給される奨学金その他の連邦・州・教育機関・雇用主による援助を充当した後の額とする。ただし、ローンと1965年高等教育法第401条（b）の資金を除く。または、（bb）次に等しい額。（AA）2011年8月1日に始まる学年度は17,500ドル。（BB）それ以降の学年度は、前年の額を、この編の第3015条（h）で定める直近の増加率と等しい率で増額した額。（b）適用日。（a）の改正は、この法律の制定日以降に始まる学年度の教育支援金の支払いに適用する。

scope: 法案本文の全文（2つの連続部分）
covered_summary_facts: 公立機関/支援対象/低い方と高い方の二段階算式/州内授業料/17,500ドル/年度/年次増額

title: 州外資格を使う教員認可

blocks.text: 44253.4. (a) The commission shall issue an authorization for a teacher to provide all of the following services to limited-English-proficient pupils:
blocks.translation: 44253.4.（a）委員会は、英語力の限られた生徒へ、次に掲げるすべての教育サービスを提供する教員の認可を発行しなければならない。

blocks.text: (b) The minimum requirements for the authorization, which may be completed at the same time as the initial preparation for the prerequisite credential or at a later date, shall include both of the following: (1) Possession of a valid California teaching credential, services credential, visiting faculty permit, children’s center instructional permit, or children’s center supervision permit which credential or permit authorizes the holder to provide instruction to pupils in preschool, kindergarten, any of grades 1 to 12, inclusive, or classes primarily organized for adults, except for the following: (A) Emergency credentials or permits. (E) Teacher education internship credentials as specified in Article 3 (commencing with Section 44450) of Chapter 3.
blocks.translation: （b）認可の最低要件には次の両方を含む。前提となる資格の初期養成と同時にも、後からも満たすことができる。（1）就学前、幼稚園、第1〜12学年、または主に成人向けの授業で教えることを認める、有効なカリフォルニア州の教員資格、教育サービス資格、客員教員許可、児童センター指導許可または監督許可を持つこと。ただし、次を除く。（A）緊急資格・許可。（B）第44333条の交換教員資格。（C）第44325条の学区インターン資格。（D）第44856条の一時滞在認定職員資格。（E）第3章第3節の教員養成実習資格。

blocks.text: (f) A teacher who possesses a credential or permit described in paragraph (1) of subdivision (b) and who is able to present a valid out-of-state credential or certificate that authorizes content instruction delivered in a pupil’s primary language may qualify for the authorization issued pursuant to this section by submitting an application and a fee to the commission.
blocks.translation: （f）（b）（1）の資格または許可を持ち、生徒の母語で教科を教えることを認める有効な州外の資格・証明書を提示できる教員は、委員会へ申請書を提出し、手数料を納めることで、この条に基づく認可を受ける資格を得ることができる。

title: 借り手の死亡と学生ローン

blocks.text: SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE. This Act may be cited as the ``Andrew Prior Act'' or ``Andrew's Law''. SEC. 2. DISCHARGE OF PRIVATE STUDENT LOANS. Section 128(e) of the Truth in Lending Act (15 U.S.C. 1638(e)) is amended by adding at the end the following: ``(12) Discharge of private educational loans in the event of the death of the borrower.-- ``(A) Definitions.--As used in this paragraph-- ``(i) the term `cosigner'-- ``(I) means any individual who is liable for the obligation of another without compensation, regardless of how designated in the contract or instrument relating to the obligation; ``(II) includes any person whose signature is requested as a condition to grant credit or to forbear on collection; and ``(III) does not include a spouse of an individual referred to in subclause (I) whose signature is needed to perfect the security interest in the loan; ``(ii) the term `private educational lender' has the same meaning as in section 140; ``(iii) the term `private education loan' has the same meaning as in section 140; and ``(iv) the term `totally and permanently disabled' means-- ``(I) with respect to a person other than a veteran, that the person is unable to engage in any substantial gainful activity because of a medically determinable physical or mental impairment that-- ``(aa) can be expected to result in death; ``(bb) has lasted for a continuous period of not less than 60 months; or ``(cc) can be expected to last for a continuous period of not less than 60 months; and ``(II) in the case of a veteran (as that term is defined in section 101 of title 38, United States Code), a determination from the Secretary of Veterans Affairs that-- ``(aa) such person has a service-connected disability or service-connected disabilities that are 100 percent disabling; or ``(bb) such person is totally disabled, based on an Individual Unemployability determination by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs.
blocks.translation: 第1条　略称。この法律は「アンドリュー・プライア法」または「アンドリュー法」と称することができる。第2条　民間学生ローンの免除。Truth in Lending Act（貸付条件の開示を定める法律）第128条（e）の末尾に次を追加する。（12）借り手の死亡時の民間教育ローンの免除。（A）定義。（i）連帯保証人とは、契約や文書上の名称を問わず、報酬なしに他人の債務の責任を負う個人をいう。融資の実行や取立て猶予の条件として署名を求められる人を含む。ただし、ローンの担保権を完成させるために署名を求められるその人の配偶者を除く。（ii）民間教育貸付業者と（iii）民間教育ローンは第140条と同じ意味とする。（iv）完全かつ永続的な障害とは、（I）退役軍人以外は、医学的に確認できる身体または精神の障害により、相当な収入を伴う仕事に就けないこと。その障害は、死亡につながる見込みがあるか、連続60か月以上続いたか、その期間続く見込みがあるものでなければならない。（II）退役軍人は、第38編第101条の定義に従い、軍務に関連する障害が100%の障害程度に当たるか、個人の就労不能に基づく全面的な障害があると退役軍人長官が認定することをいう。

blocks.text: ``(B) Private educational loans discharged.--In the event of the death of a borrower of a private educational loan, or if the borrower of a private educational loan is totally and permanently disabled, neither the estate of the borrower nor any cosigner of such private educational loan shall be obligated to repay the outstanding principal or interest on the loan. ``(C) Limitations.--The Bureau-- ``(i) shall develop such safeguards as may be necessary and appropriate to prevent fraud and abuse in the discharge of liability under this subsection; and ``(ii) notwithstanding any other provision of this subsection, may promulgate regulations to reinstate the obligation of loans discharged under this subsection in any case in which the Director determines necessary to protect the public interest.''. SEC. 3. REGULATIONS. The Director of the Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection may issue such regulations as may be necessary and appropriate to carry out this Act.
blocks.translation: （B）民間教育ローンの免除。借り手が死亡した場合、または完全かつ永続的な障害を負った場合、その借り手の遺産も連帯保証人も、未払いの元金・利息を返済する義務を負わない。（C）制限。局は、（i）この項による免除での詐欺・濫用を防ぐ必要かつ適切な措置を策定しなければならない。（ii）この項のほかの規定にかかわらず、公益を保護するため必要と局長が判断した場合、免除したローンの返済義務を復活させる規則を定めることができる。第3条　規則。消費者金融保護局長は、この法律の実施に必要かつ適切な規則を定めることができる。

scope: 法案本文の全文。定義、免除、濫用防止・義務復活、規則制定を含む。
covered_summary_facts: 法律名/改正先/死亡・永続的障害/遺産と保証人/免除/濫用防止義務/公益による復活権限

title: 退役軍人向け融資の保証料

blocks.text: SECTION 1. PERMANENT LOAN GUARANTEE FEE WAIVERS FOR VETERANS. Section 7(a) of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 636(a)) is amended-- (1) in paragraph (14)(B)(ii), by adding at the end the following: ``(III) Guarantee fee waiver for veterans.--
blocks.translation: 第1条　退役軍人の融資保証料を恒久的に免除する。中小企業法第7条（a）を次のように改める。（1）第14項（B）（ii）の末尾に次を追加する。（III）退役軍人の保証料免除。

blocks.text: ``(bb) Guarantee fee waiver.--The Administrator may not collect a guarantee fee described in paragraph (18) in connection with a loan of not more than $150,000 made under this paragraph to a veteran or spouse of a veteran on or after October 1 of the first fiscal year beginning after the date of enactment of this subclause. ``(cc) Exception.--If the President's budget for the upcoming fiscal year, submitted to Congress pursuant to section 1105(a) of title 31, United States Code, includes a cost for the program established under this subsection that is above zero, the requirements of item (bb) shall not apply to loans made during such upcoming fiscal year.'';
blocks.translation: （bb）保証料免除。長官は、この項目の制定後の最初の会計年度の10月1日以降に、この項に基づき退役軍人またはその配偶者へ行う150,000ドル以下の融資について、第18項の保証料を徴収してはならない。（cc）例外。大統領が連邦議会に提出する翌会計年度の予算に、この項の制度についてゼロを超える費用が含まれる場合、（bb）はその翌年度に行う融資に適用しない。

title: 休耕地での採草と放牧

blocks.text: SECTION 1. HAYING AND GRAZING. (a) Wheat.--Subparagraph (C) of section 107B(e)(4) of the Agricultural Act of 1949 (7 U.S.C. 1445b-3a(e)(4)(C)) is amended to read as follows: ``(C) Haying and grazing.-- ``(i) In general.--Haying and grazing of reduced acreage, acreage devoted to a conservation use under subsection (c)(1)(E), and acreage diverted from production under a land diversion program established under this section shall be permitted-- ``(I) except during any consecutive 5-month period that is established by the State committee established under section 8(b) of the Soil Conservation and Domestic Allotment Act (16 U.S.C. 590h(b)) for a State; or ``(II) during the 5-month period referred to in subclause (I) by the Secretary for any producer who elects to pay a fee equal to-- ``(aa) in the case of grazing, the grazing fee in effect as established by the Bureau of Land Management; and ``(bb) in the case of haying, a haying fee established by the Bureau of Land Management that is comparable to the grazing fee. ``(ii) 5-month period.--The State committee for a State shall, in consultation with wildlife agencies of the State, establish the 5-month period referred to in clause (i) during the period beginning April 1, and ending October 31, of a year. ``(iii) Alfalfa.--The Secretary may not exclude irrigated or irrigable acreage not planted to alfalfa when exercising the authority of the Secretary under this subparagraph.''.
blocks.translation: 第1条　採草と放牧。（a）小麦。1949年農業法第107B条（e）（4）（C）を次のように改める。（C）作付削減地、保全利用地、生産転換計画で生産から外した土地では、採草と放牧を認める。（i）（I）州委員会が定める連続5か月間を除く。または、（II）その5か月間でも、土地管理局が定める放牧料、またはそれに見合う採草料を払う生産者について、長官が認める。（ii）州委員会は州の野生生物担当機関と協議し、4月1日から10月31日までの間に、その5か月間を定める。（iii）長官はこの権限を行使する際、アルファルファを植えていない灌漑地または灌漑可能地を除外してはならない。

blocks.text: (b) Feed Grains.--Subparagraph (C) of section 105B(e)(4) of the Agricultural Act of 1949 (7 U.S.C. 1444f(e)(4)(C)) is amended to read as follows:
blocks.translation: （b）飼料穀物。1949年農業法第105B条（e）（4）（C）を次のように改める。

title: 遺跡群とナバホ・ネイション

blocks.text: SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE. This Act may be cited as the ``Chacoan Outliers Protection Act of 1993''. SEC. 2. CONFORMING AMENDMENT. (a) Section 501 of Public Law 96-550 (16 U.S.C. 410ii) is amended in the title by striking ``Congressional findings'' and inserting in lieu thereof ``Congressional findings and purpose''. (b) Section 501(b) of Public Law 96-550 (16 U.S.C. 410ii(b)) is amended by striking ``San Juan Basin;'' and inserting in lieu thereof, ``San Juan Basin and surrounding areas;''.
blocks.translation: 第1条　略称。この法律は「1993年チャコ周辺遺跡保護法」と称することができる。第2条　整合する改正。（a）公法96-550第501条の表題を「連邦議会の認定事項」から「連邦議会の認定事項と目的」へ改める。（b）同条（b）の「サンフアン盆地」を「サンフアン盆地と周辺地域」へ改める。

blocks.text: ``(b)(1) Thirty-nine outlying sites as generally depicted on a map entitled ``Chaco Culture Archeological Protection Sites'', numbered 310/80,033-B and dated September 1991, are hereby designated as `Chaco Culture Archeological Protection Sites'. The thirty-nine archeological protection sites totaling approximately 14,372 acres identified as follows:
blocks.translation: （b）（1）1991年9月の「チャコ文化考古学保護地」と題する地図に概ね示す39の周辺遺跡を、チャコ文化考古学保護地に指定する。39保護地の合計面積は約14,372エーカーで、次のとおりである。

blocks.text: SEC. 4. ASSISTANCE TO THE NAVAJO NATION. Section 506 of Public Law 96-550 (16 U.S.C. 410ii-5) is amended by adding the following new subsection at the end thereof: ``(f) The Secretary is authorized to assist the Navajo Nation in the protection and management of those Chaco Culture Archeological Protection Sites located on lands under the jurisdiction of the Navajo Nation through a grant, contract, or cooperative agreement entered into pursuant to the Indian Self-Determination and Education Act (Public Law 93-638), as amended, to assist the Navajo Nation in site planning, resource protection, interpretation, resource management actions, and such other purposes as may be identified in such grant, contract, or cooperative agreement.''.
blocks.translation: 第4条　ナバホ・ネイションへの支援。公法96-550第506条の末尾に次を追加する。（f）長官は、ナバホ・ネイションの管轄地にあるチャコ文化考古学保護地の保護・管理を支援できる。インディアン自決・教育法に基づく補助金・契約・協力協定を用い、遺跡計画、資源保護、解説、資源管理、その他協定等に掲げる目的を支援する。

title: 生活費に応じた人的控除

blocks.text: SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE. This Act may be cited as the ``The Personal Exemption Fairness Act of 2010''. SEC. 2. REGIONAL COST-OF-LIVING ADJUSTMENTS IN PERSONAL EXEMPTIONS. (a) In General.--Subsection (d) of section 151 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph: ``(5) Area cost-of-living adjustment.-- ``(A) In general.--Each of the dollar amounts otherwise in effect under paragraphs (1) and (3)(C) for any taxable year beginning after 2010 shall be multiplied by the applicable multiplier for the taxable year which applies to the statistical area in which the taxpayer's primary place of abode during the taxable year is located. ``(B) Applicable multipliers.--For purposes of this paragraph-- ``(i) In general.--Not later than December 15 of each calendar year, the Secretary shall prescribe an applicable multiplier for each statistical area of the United States which shall apply to taxable years beginning during the succeeding calendar year. ``(ii) Determination of multipliers.-- ``(I) In the case of a statistical area where the cost-of-living differential for the calendar year does not exceed 125 percent, the applicable multiplier is 1. ``(II) In the case of a statistical area not described in subclause (I), the applicable multiplier is the cost- of-living differential for the calendar year.
blocks.translation: 第1条　略称。この法律は「2010年人的控除公平法」と称することができる。第2条　人的控除の地域生活費調整。（a）1986年内国歳入法第151条（d）の末尾に次を追加する。（5）（A）2010年後に始まる各課税年度について、第1項と第3項（C）の金額に、納税者の主たる住居のある統計地域の、その年度の適用乗率を掛ける。（B）（i）長官は毎年12月15日までに、米国の各統計地域について、翌暦年に始まる課税年度に適用する乗率を定める。（ii）（I）その年の地域生活費の全国平均に対する比率が125%以下なら、適用乗率は1。（II）それ以外は、その地域生活費の全国平均に対する比率を適用乗率とする。

blocks.text: ``(iii) Cost of living differential.--The cost-of-living differential for any statistical area for any calendar year is the percentage determined by dividing-- ``(I) the cost-of-living for such area for the preceding calendar year, by ``(II) the average cost-of-living for the United States for the preceding calendar year. ``(iv) Cost-of-living for area.-- ``(I) In general.--For each calendar year beginning after 2009, the Secretary of Labor shall determine and publish a cost-of-living index for each statistical area. ``(II) Methodology.--The cost-of- living index determined under subclause (I) for any statistical area for any calendar year shall be based on average market prices for the area for the 12- month period ending on August 31 of such calendar year. The market prices taken into account under the preceding sentence shall be selected and used under the same methodology as is used by the Secretary of Labor in developing the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers. ``(v) Statistical area.--For purposes of this subsection the term `statistical area' means-- ``(I) any metropolitan statistical area as defined by the Secretary of Commerce, and ``(II) the portion of any State not within a metropolitan statistical area as so defined.''. (b) Effective Date.-- (1) In general.--The amendments made by this section shall apply to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2010. (2) Transition rule.--Notwithstanding section 151(d)(5)(B) of the Internal Revenue Code (as added by this section), the date for prescribing applicable multipliers for taxable years beginning in calendar year 2011 shall be the date 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act.

title: 学生数を単位時間から数える

blocks.text: SECTION 1. DEFINITION OF INDIAN STUDENT COUNT. Section 117(h) of the Carl D. Perkins Vocational and Technical Education Act of 1998 (20 U.S.C. 2327(h)) is amended by striking paragraph (2) and inserting the following: ``(2) Indian student count.-- ``(A) In general.--The term `Indian student count' means a number equal to the total number of Indian students enrolled in each tribally-controlled postsecondary vocational and technical institution, as determined in accordance with subparagraph (B). ``(B) Determination.-- ``(i) Enrollment.--For each academic year, the Indian student count shall be determined on the basis of the enrollments of Indian students as in effect at the conclusion of-- ``(I) in the case of the fall term, the third week of the fall term; and ``(II) in the case of the spring term, the third week of the spring term.
blocks.translation: 第1条　先住民学生数の定義。1998年カール・D・パーキンズ職業・技術教育法第117条（h）（合衆国法典第20編第2327条（h））の第2項を次に置き換える。（2）（A）先住民学生数とは、中等教育後の職業・技術教育を行う部族運営の各機関に在籍する先住民学生の総数に相当し、（B）により算定する数をいう。（B）（i）各学年度の在籍数は、秋学期と春学期それぞれの第3週が終わった時点で定める。

blocks.text: ``(ii) Calculation.--For each academic year, the Indian student count for a tribally- controlled postsecondary vocational and technical institution shall be the quotient obtained by dividing-- ``(I) the sum of the credit-hours of all Indian students enrolled in the tribally-controlled postsecondary vocational and technical institution (as determined under clause (i)); by ``(II) 12. ``(iii) Summer term.--Any credit earned in a class offered during a summer term shall be counted in the determination of the Indian student count for the succeeding fall term.
blocks.translation: （ii）各学年度の先住民学生数は、その機関に在籍する先住民学生全員の履修単位数の合計を12で割った値とする。（iii）夏学期の授業で取得した単位は、次の秋学期の学生数の算定に含める。

blocks.text: ``(iv) Students without secondary school degrees.-- ``(I) In general.--A credit earned at a tribally-controlled postsecondary vocational and technical institution by any Indian student that has not obtained a secondary school degree (or the recognized equivalent of such a degree) shall be counted toward the determination of the Indian student count if the institution at which the student is enrolled has established criteria for the admission of the student on the basis of the ability of the student to benefit from the education or training of the institution. ``(II) Presumption.--The institution shall be presumed to have established the criteria described in subclause (I) if the admission procedures for the institution include counseling or testing that measures the aptitude of a student to successfully complete a course in which the student is enrolled. ``(III) Credits toward secondary school degree.--No credit earned by an Indian student for the purpose of obtaining a secondary school degree (or the recognized equivalent of such a degree) shall be counted toward the determination of the Indian student count under this clause. ``(v) Continuing education programs.--Any credit earned by an Indian student in a continuing education program of a tribally- controlled postsecondary vocational and technical institution shall be included in the determination of the sum of all credit hours of the student if the credit is converted to a credit-hour basis in accordance with the system of the institution for providing credit for participation in the program.''.
blocks.translation: （iv）中等学校卒業資格のない学生。（I）卒業資格または同等資格を得ていない学生の取得単位も、その機関が教育・訓練を受けて学習上の成果を得られる能力に基づく入学基準を設けていれば、学生数の算定に含める。（II）入学手続に、履修課程を修了する適性を測るカウンセリングまたは試験が含まれれば、その基準があると推定する。（III）中等学校卒業資格または同等資格の取得を目的とした単位は、この規定による学生数に算入しない。（v）継続教育の単位は、その機関の参加単位の認定制度に従って履修単位数に換算されれば、学生の総履修単位数に含める。

blocks.text: (5) Specifically state the length of time that recorded data is to be stored. (A) Unless subparagraph (B) or (C) applies, nonevidentiary data including video and audio recorded by a body-worn camera should be retained for a minimum of 60 days, after which it may be erased, destroyed, or recycled. An agency may keep data for more than 60 days to have it available in case of a citizen complaint and to preserve transparency. (B) Evidentiary data including video and audio recorded by a body-worn camera under this section should be retained for a minimum of two years under any of the following circumstances: (i) The recording is of an incident involving the use of force by a peace officer or an officer-involved shooting. (ii) The recording is of an incident that leads to the detention or arrest of an individual. (iii) The recording is relevant to a formal or informal complaint against a law enforcement officer or a law enforcement agency. (C) If evidence that may be relevant to a criminal prosecution is obtained from a recording made by a body-worn camera under this section, the law enforcement agency should retain the recording for any time in addition to that specified in paragraphs (A) and (B), and in the same manner as is required by law for other evidence that may be relevant to a criminal prosecution.
blocks.translation: （5）データの保存期間を明記する。（A）（B）または（C）が適用される場合を除き、証拠性のない映像・音声は最低60日保存することが望ましく、その後は消去・廃棄・再利用できる。市民の苦情に備え、透明性を守るため、60日を超えて保持してもよい。（B）証拠性のある映像・音声は、警察官の実力行使や発砲、人の拘束・逮捕につながる事件、または警察官・機関への正式・非正式な苦情に関連する場合、最低2年保存することが望ましい。（C）刑事訴追に関係し得る証拠が映像から得られた場合、ほかの同種の証拠について法が求めるのと同じ方法で、（A）（B）の期間を超えて保存するべきである。

blocks.text: (c) (1) For purposes of this section, “evidentiary data” refers to data of an incident or encounter that could prove useful for investigative purposes, including, but not limited to, a crime, an arrest or citation, a search, a use of force incident, or a confrontational encounter with a member of the public. The retention period for evidentiary data are subject to state evidentiary laws. (2) For purposes of this section, “nonevidentiary data” refers to data that does not necessarily have value to aid in an investigation or prosecution, such as data of an incident or encounter that does not lead to an arrest or citation, or data of general activities the officer might perform while on duty.
blocks.translation: （c）（1）証拠性のあるデータとは、犯罪、逮捕・違反告知、捜索、実力行使、市民との対立的な接触など、捜査に役立ち得る出来事・接触のデータをいう。保存期間には州の証拠法が適用される。（2）証拠性のないデータとは、逮捕・違反告知に至らない出来事や、勤務中の一般的な活動など、捜査・訴追に必ずしも役立たないデータをいう。

scope: 方針策定(b)、無断利用禁止(b)(3)、保存期間(b)(5)(A)〜(C)、二種類のデータ定義(c)を抜粋。担当者・分類・保存先などの他規定を省略。
covered_summary_facts: 警察機関の検討義務/ダウンロード保存/無断使用複製配布の禁止/証拠性別の期間と定義
